name: The Sewers' Road
summary: The exile route: the road walked by those who refused the Edict's needle-tongue punishment and chose silence in a foreign tongue instead. It runs from Velkash north through the Wealdmark toward the Dusk Reach. Its waystones bear carved mouths — some open, some sewn shut.

geography.character: footpath and cart-track, unmarked on official charts, kept by custom rather than law
geography.route: Velkash's north gate → Wealdmark river-farms → forest-edge sanctuaries → the Dusk Reach

crossings.name: The Open-Mouth Stones
crossings.note: Waystones where refugees left messages for those behind them; the sewn-mouth stones mark where informers were buried.

lore_notes: Dating to the Edict of Silence (Age of Silence), the road is still walked — by Rememberers' couriers, by deserters, and by people who simply cannot stay.
The Wealdmark's farms along it never ask names; the code of the road there is older than any charter.
adventure_hooks: A new sewn-mouth stone appears with fresh carving; nobody has been reported dead, which is worse.
Players are asked to walk the road backward — carrying someone out of the Dusk Reach who cannot be seen leaving it.
